That contradicts "one pair of matching quotes" and the claim in e2 that the mismatched-quote test passes. Resubmit with a command whose input has matching quotes on a value, plus an unmatched-quote case that keeps its quote.

The `git diff CHANGELOG.md` excerpt shows a new bullet under "## Unreleased" that describes the parse_env fix: comments and blanks skipped, quotes stripped, '=' preserved.
